value.content: {"cve_id": "CVE-2022-44877", "software": "CentOS Web Panel (CWP)", "cvss": 9.8, "vulnerability_type": "SQL_INJECTION", "cwe": "CWE-89", "affected_versions": "CWP 7 prior to version 0.9.8.1147", "architecture_root_cause": "Unauthenticated access to administrative logging route accepted unescaped input that was concatenated into audit database queries before session validation.", "detection_signals": ["cwp_login_panel", "login_index_audit", "parameter_concatenation"], "verification_strategy": "Measure differential response codes when supplying valid vs malformed character sequences in authentication audit fields.", "evidence_requirements": ["audit_differential_response", "database_exception_signature"], "remediation": "Update CWP to the latest release; enforce authentication before database logging; use prepared statements across all administrative logging scripts."}
